title: OSF UI
description: Runtime and overlay behavior for the OSF UI framework.

settings.label: Open / Close key
settings.hint: Press to rebind the key that opens and closes the overlay.

settings.label: Language
settings.hint: Use auto for Starfield's language, or enter a locale such as en, de, or pt-BR.

settings.label: Pause-menu entry
settings.hint: Add a MOD MENUS entry to the game's pause menu.

settings.label: Warn about game-key collisions
settings.hint: Show hard and possible warnings when mod hotkeys overlap Starfield's live bindings. The read-only game catalog stays visible when this is off.

settings.label: Show render stats
settings.hint: Show fresh view FPS and pipeline timings on every view, and write periodic diagnostics to the OSF UI logs. Sampling adds a small amount of work.

settings.label: Bug reporting
settings.hint: Allow sending diagnostic reports to the OSF UI maintainer: manual reports from System Health and the prompt after a crash. Nothing is ever sent without your confirmation. Turning this off applies to the crash prompt on the next launch.
